 Predictions and form stats 
 Here are the predictions for WBBL 2026 matches 29 and 30, featuring Hobart Hurricanes vs Sydney Thunder at Bellerive Oval and Sydney Sixers vs Perth Scorchers at North Sydney Oval on November 21.
 Match Prediction - Hobart Hurricanes Women v Sydney Thunder Women 
 LIVE SCORES - 29th Match - Hobart Hurricanes Women vs Sydney Thunder Women (Bellerive Oval, Hobart) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Bellerive Oval, Hobart (Women's Big Bash League) - 144
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Bellerive Oval, Hobart (Women's Big Bash League) - 132
 Current Form Hobart Hurricanes Women: 
 Hobart Hurricanes Women are currently placed at the bottom most position on points table with 7 losses to their credit. They have 0 point to their name. Their NRR is -1.967.
 The top run scorer for Hobart Hurricanes Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Nicola Carey with 197 runs to her name.
 The top wicket taker for Hobart Hurricanes Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Heather Graham with 9 scalps under her belt.
 Hobart Hurricanes Women have lost their previous match against Perth Scorchers Women by 28 runs.
 Perth Scorchers Women batted first and they posted a total of 148 before being bowled out. Beth Mooney and Sophie Devine got out without troubling the scorers much. After their dismissals, Katie Mack and Chloe Piparo made 30 and 33 runs respectively to revive the innings. Freya Kemp also contributed quite well in the middle order. She smashed 40 runs in only 20 deliveries, collecting 7 boundaries. On the back of the momentum she infused into the innings, Perth Scorchers Women managed to get to a competitive total of 148 on a tough surface to bat on.
 During the chase, Hobart Hurricanes Women lost their way right from the outset. They were reduced to 36 for 4 in the 7th over itself. After that phase, Nicola Carey and Maddy Green carted the bowlers to all parts. Carey scored 32 while Green smashed 50 runs off only 32 deliveries. However, both of them got out at a very wrong time. The lower order batters failed to make any impact whatsoever and Hobart Hurricanes Women were bowled out for just 120, losing the game by 28 runs.
 Current Form Sydney Thunder Women: 
 Sydney Thunder Women are currently placed at the 4th position on points table with 3 wins and 4 losses to their credit. They have 6 points to their name. Their NRR is 0.154.
 The top run scorer for Sydney Thunder Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Anika Learoyd with 267 runs to her name.
 The top wicket taker for Sydney Thunder Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Samantha Bates with 8 scalps under her belt.
 Sydney Thunder Women have won their previous match against Brisbane Heat Women by 6 wickets.
 Brisbane Heat Women batted first and they posted a huge total of 225 for 3 in 20 overs. Grace Harris and Charli Knott got their team off to a flier. Harris hit 9 fours and 9 sixes for her innings of 121 in 67 balls while Knott scored 62 runs in just 34 balls. Both added 118 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Yastika Bhatia also made some valuable runs at the back end to help Brisbane Heat Women get to a massive total of 225 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Sydney Thunder Women couldn't really get off to a stable start. Both Phoebe Litchfield and Georgia Voll threw their wicket away cheaply. After their dismissals, Anika Learoyd and Heather Knight played to their potential and scored 60 and 43 runs respectively to bring Sydney Thunder Women back in the game. A real match winning knock was played by Laura Harris, who smashed 63 runs in only 20 deliveries as Sydney Thunder Women managed to chase the target down from an impossible situation in the last over with 6 wickets in hand.
